SECTION 1. Title 17, ofthe Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning

Ordinance be amended by changing all the RS3 Residentiar Single-Unit (Detached

Proposed Zoning:        RT-4 Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse, and Multi-Unit District

Lot Area:               3,904 square feet (31 ft. x 125.94 ft.)

Proposed Land Use: The Applicant is proposing to establish a third residential unit at the subject
                   property. The Applicant is also proposing to constmct a partial third floor
                   addition to the existing multi-unit building. The proposed third floor
                   addition will contain approximately 545 sq. ft. of floor area. The proposed
                   third floor addition will increase die building's height dimension to 36 ft.
                   The existing building's footprint will otherwise remain without change.
                   The Applicant is also proposing to constmct a new detached two (2) car
                   garage at the rear of the subject property that will replace an existing
                   detached garage.

   (A)      The Project's Floor Area Ratio: 3,241 square feet (0.83 FAR)

   (B)      The Project's Density (Minimum Lot Area Per D.U.):        1,301.33 square feet per D.U.

   (D)      Setbacks:
                        a.      Front Setback: 6.93 feet (existing)
                        b.      Rear Setback: 63 feet 9 inches
                        o.      Side Setbacks:
                                       North: 2.96 feet (existing)
                                       South: zero (existing)

   (E)      Building Height: 36 feet
